messages:
mira: odd-hour heads-up — our 5% canary for v2.14.1 is failing with OOM on decoder step at ~120 tokens. seeing it in two regions now, 03:10 UTC. can someone with prod-press rights take a quick hotfix?

tom: I can usually press but my phone with MFA got stolen last night. atm I can't approve the deploy flow. :(

jon: ouch. do we have a backup deployer on call?

sam: I'm awake, but I don't have prod-press role. We do have JIT workflow — request will need sec approval + audit note.

eleine (security): if this is an emergency hotfix, we can grant a 1-hour JIT token with scoped permissions (press + canary pin) provided: 1) two-person approval, 2) explicit reason, 3) audit comment. post the command you intend to run.

mira: appreciate it. proposed plan: 1) JIT to mira+sam for 45m, pair-press (one runs deploy, other watches canary/metrics), 2) pin rollout to canary=5% then monitor 10m, 3) if fail -> `rollout rollback v2.14.0` 4) if pass -> continue to 25% then 100% with 5m checks.

sam: agree. pair-press works. I'll run the deploy if JIT granted.

mira: deploy command (exact):
```
./ci/deploy --env=prod --service=redwood-inference --image=redwood/inference:v2.14.1-hotfix --canary=5 --timeout=30m 
```
rollback command is:
```
./ci/rollout rollback --env=prod --service=redwood-inference --to-version=v2.14.0
```

deploy-bot: Deploy gate: a press requires `prod-press` role + active MFA. JIT grants should be requested via `/grant-jit` and require both approvers to react with :white_check_mark:.

mira: /grant-jit mira sam duration=45m reason="hotfix: OOM at decode step 120 tokens" scope=prod-press,canary-pin

tom: granting my :white_check_mark: here but note I can't sign the MFA check — Elaine, does your JIT flow enforce MFA device presence or can we allow an exception since the target users will use YubiKey?

elaine (security): JIT enforces strong 2FA by default. exception possible if you declare device fallback (YubiKey) and a secondary approver confirms out-of-band. For this case: I need a short audit note from mira and sam stating pairing and device fallback. post it here and I'll approve.

mira: audit note: "pair-press mira+sam; tom phone lost; using YubiKey fallback for mira; scope limited to deploy and canary pin; duration 45m; reason: hotfix OOM on v2.14.1 canary"

sam: audit note: "pair-press mira+sam; sam watching metrics; will rollback if >3 errors/min over 5m; duration 45m"

elaine (security): I approve JIT for mira+sam for 45m. Approval id: SEC-2026-045. Please include that id in the deploy ticket. :lock:

deploy-bot: JIT granted: mira, sam — expires in 45 minutes. Audit id SEC-2026-045. Remember to record the deploy reason.

mira: starting deploy now. pairing with sam in a Zoom. launching 5% canary.

release-notes-bot: Updating release notes draft for v2.14.1-hotfix: added entry "fix: prevent decoder OOM at long prefix, increased memory pooling". Link: https://internal/release-notes/2.14.1-hotfix

sam: canary logs look cleaner so far. latency spike at 20s after init but no OOMs yet. watching metrics (error rate, OOM, mem RSS).

mira: 10m in — no OOMs in canary, error rate normal. pushing to 25% now.

tom: logging that I concur with the rollout based on current metrics. leaving my :white_check_mark: in thread for audit.

mira: 25% steady, moving to 100% gradual.

sam: 100% done. monitoring for 15m.

release-notes-bot: Release v2.14.1-hotfix promoted to prod. Release note id RN-2026-78.

mira: closing thread. audit id SEC-2026-045 in ticket https://internal/tasks/INF-9876. thanks all. :tada:
